title: A ratiometric dual-fluorescent paper-based synthetic biosensor for visual detection of tetracycline on-site.
authors: Liu, Yanger; Wu, Yifan; Wang, Lei; Zhu, Longjiao; Dong, Yulan; Xu, Wentao
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于TetR转录因子结合位点改造的纸基生物传感器检测四环素，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点筛选和分子对接，但核心是传感应用而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，AI/物理模拟方法深度有限。
abstract: The excessive use of tetracycline poses a threat to human health, making it essential to monitor and regulate its usage. While whole-cell biosensors offer a simple and cost-effective method, their utility is constrained by limitations in sensitivity, portability, and robustness, hindering real-time measurements within complex environmental contexts. In this study, a ratiometric i/cTetR synthetic biosensing test strip with an engineered modified dual-fluorescence reporting was developed for detecting Tet antibiotics in water and food. First, the standardized unidirectional promoter PtetR by tailoring and screening TetR transcription factor binding sites and verified by molecular docking, shortening the detection time. Secondly, decoupling the sensing and reporting modules enhances the biosensor's performance, eliminating genetic background leakage and tripling the output signal. Thirdly, a ratiometric dual fluorescence signal i/cTetR biosensing test strip was designed. Under the light box LED/UV light source, the dual signal output method significantly reduced false negative results and enhanced the anti-interference capability of the biosensor. The i/cTetR strips can detect Tet in tap water (5-1280 mug/mL) and milk (50-3200 mug/kg) within 45 min in high volume on-site without separation and purification. This study provides a standardized and universal sensing method for the field detection of antibiotic contaminants.
abstract_zh: 四环素的过度使用对人类健康构成威胁，因此监测和调控其使用至关重要。尽管全细胞生物传感器提供了一种简单且成本效益高的方法，但其在灵敏度、便携性和稳健性方面的局限性阻碍了在复杂环境背景下的实时测量。本研究开发了一种基于工程化修饰双荧光报告的比例型i/cTetR合成生物传感试纸条，用于检测水和食品中的四环素类抗生素。首先，通过定制和筛选TetR转录因子结合位点，并利用分子对接 (molecular docking) 验证，标准化了单向启动子PtetR，缩短了检测时间。其次，解耦传感与报告模块增强了生物传感器的性能，消除了遗传背景泄漏，并将输出信号提高了三倍。第三，设计了一种比例型双荧光信号i/cTetR生物传感试纸条。在灯箱LED/UV光源下，双信号输出方法显著减少了假阴性结果，并增强了生物传感器的抗干扰能力。i/cTetR试纸条可在45分钟内，无需分离和纯化，高容量现场检测自来水（5-1280 μg/mL）和牛奶（50-3200 μg/kg）中的四环素。本研究为抗生素污染物的现场检测提供了一种标准化且通用的传感方法。
